propositions: When a bug is closed with --class duplicate but lacks a recorded duplicates link, the close_precheck gate falls through to the LLM completion verifier, which fails with no guidance on the one remedy (recording the duplicates link).
The gate must hard-fail before any LLM call when closing a duplicate with no live replacement link, raising CommandError with the exact rebar link command needed.
A duplicates link whose target is closed (not open) must still satisfy the gate requirement, since closing a duplicate of an already-closed canonical is the common case.
A duplicates link naming an archived or unresolvable target must produce a distinct error message (dead-target message) rather than the no-link message.
The hard-fail scope is limited to --class duplicate alone; --class not_a_bug and --class escalated retain the prior fallthrough behavior since neither owes a duplicates link.
